hint: multi-curve figure labels: a curve formula must stand within 20 px of its own curve with no other curve as close (LABEL_NEAREST_CURVE_MISMATCH), and an asymptote value x=p or y=q within 12 px of its own dashed line with no other dashed line as close (ASYMPTOTE_LABEL_DETACHED). The engine already tries the places beside the own stroke nearest first; a label with no free spot there (a tall fraction in a small window) keeps an ordinary place marked data-near-room=NONE and is judged by ownership only (own stroke nearest, within 64 px; asymptote value within 40 px); when even that fails the figure is too crowded: hide the label you can say in the caption (curves[].hideLabel or hideLabels:["asymptotes"]), shorten the label, draw fewer curves, or widen the window with the viewport field.
